title: Hark previews a browser agent for errands, bookings and research
friendlyTitle: Hark shows an AI helper for browser tasks
summary: Hark opened a waitlist for Handoff, a browser-use agent intended to navigate websites without official APIs and complete tasks such as shopping, reservations and research. The company claims its action-prediction approach is faster and cheaper than rival models, but the public demo showed only part of a task.
friendlySummary: Handoff aims to shop, book tables and research on websites for you. It is not fully available yet, and the demo did not show a complete task.
whyItMatters: Browser agents could remove repetitive form-filling and comparison work from daily life. The limited evidence is a reminder to demand end-to-end success rates, confirmation before purchases and safe recovery when a site changes or the agent makes a mistake.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could save time, but users need clear checks before the agent buys, books or sends anything.
